message.dungeontotems.zombified.shulker: Your zombie hands are too clumsy.
zombie.dungeontotems.thought.enigma: The Inner machinations of my mind are an enigma even to me. Alas, I am a zombie
zombie.dungeontotems.thought.sorry_jest: Lo, what sorry jest is this, that I who once did read the stars must now be vexed by a sword's plain name?
zombie.dungeontotems.thought.rotted_vess: Methinks this rotted vessel yet remembers the scholar it once housed, as an empty church remembers its hymns.
zombie.dungeontotems.thought.cruel_fortu: O cruel Fortune, to leave me wit enough to know my wit is gone.
zombie.dungeontotems.thought.hunger_ridd: I hunger, yet I know not wherefore; I think, yet know not how. Such is the riddle of the walking dead.
zombie.dungeontotems.thought.mind_entomb: Here lies a mind entombed within its own flesh, and the tomb, alas, still walks.
zombie.dungeontotems.thought.letters_swi: These letters swim before mine eyes like fish in a muddied brook; I was learnèd once, I swear it on my grave.
zombie.dungeontotems.thought.piece_of_wo: What a piece of work is a zombie: how ignoble in reason, how finite in faculty, how fond of brains.
zombie.dungeontotems.thought.ruin_philos: Be not deceived by my groaning. Within this ruin there dwells a philosopher, and he is most displeased.
zombie.dungeontotems.thought.to_read: To read, or not to read? Alas, the choice was never mine.
zombie.dungeontotems.thought.horror_by_c: Forgive me, gentle reader, for I am become the very horror I once read of by candlelight.
